svg.text: OpenMUPP on the ST-Link/V2-1 of a Nucleo-64 board (BOARD=stlinkv21)
Layout of MB1360 (UM2324). MB1136 has the same MCU pins, but other connector and pad names. 3.3 V targets only: no level shifters.
The probe does not supply the target. Connect GND, and power the target from its own supply.
LED: green idle, red bootloader or fault
Bottom side: SWD of the ST-Link MCU, to write the bootloader
Seen from the bottom. Use the pad on the side away from CN4 (gold). The pads next to CN4 (grey) connect to CN4.
JP1: one pin is NRST, the other GND. Find the GND pin with a continuity test.
